message.content:
The full quote is: **“Businesses owned by responsible and organized merchants shall eventually surpass those owned by wealthy rulers.”** It is attributed to **Ibn Khaldun** in *Muqaddimah* 2:272–73, as quoted in Weiss (1995). [1][5]

If you want, I can also help identify the source text, explain the meaning, or check whether a different version of the quote is more accurate.
